description: Real-time US stock, ETF or index quote (replacement for the closed IEX Cloud public quote): company name, exchange, last sale price, net and % change, bid/ask price and size, volume, last trade time, market status (pre-market, open, after-hours, closed) with the regular-session close, day high/low, 52-week range and upcoming earnings date. Data from Nasdaq.com's public quote API. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_alpha_vantage_public when you need Alpha Vantage global quote for one stock or ETF ticker; crypto_etherscan_label_cloud when you need Etherscan public address-label cloud: entity labels. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
